claims.text: Therapist guided CBT-I improved sleep onset latency in a randomized trial of 120 adults.
The improvement in sleep onset latency persisted at six-month follow-up.
The evidence supports conclusions about sleep initiation but not broad improvement across all insomnia symptoms or adult subgroups.
Because patients with comorbid depression were excluded, findings should not be generalized to insomnia with comorbid depression.
Durability should be limited to the observed six-month follow-up, without claims of longer-term persistence.
